scope: Local registered-demo acceptance; compiler unavailable for public integration; independent review and publication held

demos.execution: Unmodified public Python admit runs in Pyodide
demos.inputs: Editable JSONL and local-file import
demos.normal: Correct archive returns reconstructed rows
demos.boundary: Bad clock, off-grid number, recording gap
demos.repair: Edit the named record and rerun Python
demos.reset: Start over clears input/results/history
demos.provenance: Pinned public source, synthetic fixtures, visitor input
demos.journey: Run bad clock; repair it; import correct template; inspect receipt
demos.principle: Admission is a sequence of checks over immutable input bytes
demos.intermediate: Named gates, declared clocks, returned rows and the exact Python reason
demos.tradeoff: Reject bad metadata instead of inventing a usable book

demos.execution: Unmodified public guard.py runs in Pyodide
demos.inputs: Typed command plus benign and blocked examples
demos.normal: Benign command returns actual policy verdict
demos.boundary: Dangerous or malformed command refused; runtime failure separate
demos.repair: Edit command and rerun; recover unavailable runtime
demos.reset: Shared reset rebuilds terminal; clear/history supported
demos.provenance: Pinned public guard, no host command execution
demos.journey: Type a benign command and a denied one; read actual reason
demos.principle: Policy decisions explain which command patterns are permitted
demos.intermediate: Actual Python verdict and reason for the typed command
demos.tradeoff: A policy allowance is not command execution or a security guarantee

demos.execution: Implemented BM25 lexical ranking over site corpus
demos.inputs: Free query, example queries, BM25/count comparison
demos.normal: Matching passages show per-term score contributions
demos.boundary: No matching passage and unavailable corpus states
demos.repair: Change query or retry failed corpus load
demos.reset: Shared reset restores example query and ranking mode
demos.provenance: Own site text; independent lexical implementation, no vector claim
demos.journey: Search a term, compare count/BM25, inspect contribution and passage
demos.principle: Lexical relevance depends on term rarity and document length
demos.intermediate: BM25/count comparison and per-term score contributions
demos.tradeoff: Transparent ranking is inspectable but lacks semantic understanding

demos.execution: Implemented log-return trend-rule simulation
demos.inputs: Editable numeric CSV, local import, correct/invalid templates and live parameters
demos.normal: Yesterday-based rule produces cumulative returns
demos.boundary: Invalid values and chronology, no prior signal, no available candle, delayed file import and reset are checked
demos.repair: Named physical-line validation errors; edit data, rerun and inspect the exact exported result
demos.reset: Shared reset restores seed and hidden leaky result
demos.provenance: Synthetic returns and independent teaching code
demos.journey: Bring returns; change signal availability; inspect a trade and repair leakage
demos.principle: A decision may only use a return already available
demos.intermediate: Cursor links signal source, exposure, turnover cost and cumulative result
demos.tradeoff: Simplified log exposure illustrates leakage, not an executable strategy

demos.execution: Actual matching-engine fills, resting orders and cancellation; invalid quantity and seed rejected
demos.inputs: Visitor-authored limit/market orders, cancel, replay/hold-to-step and seed
demos.normal: Orders consume resting liquidity by price and time
demos.boundary: Empty/crossing book handled by real matching logic
demos.repair: No manual order or input validation surface at baseline
demos.reset: Seed change resets and warms a new tape
demos.provenance: Synthetic event tape; own matching engine, no live C++ claim
demos.journey: Place an order, inspect fills and remaining book, cancel/replay
demos.principle: Price/time matching updates remaining quantities and trades
demos.intermediate: Visible order ladder, fill/remaining counts and cancel state
demos.tradeoff: An in-browser order model does not reproduce an exchange

demos.execution: Validation selects one candidate; unopened test never changes choice or chart scale; edits reseal
demos.inputs: Editable horizon/direction candidates, seed, selected day and explicit open-test action
demos.normal: Candidate picked by validation; test shown only for chosen one
demos.boundary: Sealed test influences plot scale at baseline
demos.repair: No custom candidate windows; no inspectable daily pairs
demos.reset: Shared reset restores market and seals test
demos.provenance: Synthetic panel; independent scoring implementation
demos.journey: Choose candidate horizons, inspect day-wise ranks, freeze selection before test
demos.principle: Candidate selection precedes access to the later audit window
demos.intermediate: Training/validation ranking and day-level asset ranks; only chosen test opens
demos.tradeoff: A later window loses its independence if the visitor keeps tuning on it

demos.execution: Actual quote, fill, cash and inventory ledger; worked two-fill case and input-error repair
demos.inputs: Editable/imported fair-value and taker-flow CSV, spread, skew and event cursor
demos.normal: Quotes trade with synthetic takers and update inventory/P&L
demos.boundary: Wide quotes and high inventory create visible tradeoffs
demos.repair: Cannot supply flow or inspect a fill computation at baseline
demos.reset: Shared reset restores spread/skew/seed
demos.provenance: Synthetic fair value and takers; no profitability claim
demos.journey: Edit a flow, replay takers, inspect quote/fill/cash identity
demos.principle: Quotes trade spread capture against inventory exposure
demos.intermediate: Each taker event exposes quote, execution, inventory and marked cash
demos.tradeoff: Wider spread can reduce fills; skew alters exposure in the simplified flow model

demos.execution: Implemented candle-stamp walk-forward audit
demos.inputs: Editable numeric CSV, local import, correct/invalid templates and live parameters
demos.normal: Close-stamped candles are only read after completion
demos.boundary: Invalid values and chronology, no prior signal, no available candle, delayed file import and reset are checked
demos.repair: Named physical-line validation errors; edit data, rerun and inspect the exact exported result
demos.reset: Shared reset restores close stamps and seed
demos.provenance: Synthetic five-minute candles; not upstream code/data
demos.journey: Edit available times, identify a leaking read, repair and rerun
demos.principle: Publication availability and bar-close clocks are different
demos.intermediate: Decision cursor shows the specific candle used and its actual close
demos.tradeoff: Declared clocks can be inconsistent; no timestamp authentication is claimed

demos.execution: Implemented historical version selection
demos.inputs: Cutoff, latest/as-of policy, three guided scenarios
demos.normal: Only versions known at cutoff are returned
demos.boundary: Before-data/late-correction cases show withheld/future values
demos.repair: Move cutoff or use historical policy to repair future reads
demos.reset: Dedicated reset restores historical policy and cutoff
demos.provenance: Synthetic version store; inspectable full revision history
demos.journey: Compare historical/latest reads and every source revision
demos.principle: A historical query should only see versions already published
demos.intermediate: Version records and query-time result change together
demos.tradeoff: Late corrections must not rewrite what the query could know then

demos.execution: Compare-and-swap retries stale reads; last-write-wins exhibits the actual overwrite trace
demos.inputs: Manual writer read/commit steps and collision/serialized schedules
demos.normal: CAS retries stale writers until updates survive
demos.boundary: Last-write-wins overwrites concurrent updates
demos.repair: Protocol repairs loss but individual transitions lack an inspector
demos.reset: Shared reset restores initial race parameters
demos.provenance: Synthetic scheduler; illustrates concurrency, not private platform code
demos.journey: Replay a race step and inspect held/current version before commit
demos.principle: A stale read can overwrite a completed write
demos.intermediate: Manual writer schedule and read/commit/version/retry trace
demos.tradeoff: Compare-and-swap preserves changes at the cost of retries

demos.execution: Implemented CSV parsing and historical version queries
demos.inputs: Editable/imported CSV, query cutoff and selectors
demos.normal: Query returns source lines and revision timeline
demos.boundary: Malformed/duplicate/future data is named and refused/withheld
demos.repair: Edit offending CSV line and rerun query
demos.reset: Dedicated reset restores input/query/results
demos.provenance: Visitor local input or synthetic template; independent public code
demos.journey: Import records, repair a named row, query and export provenance
demos.principle: Version selection and memory retention are explicit policies
demos.intermediate: Editable records, visible query states and version-reclamation trace
demos.tradeoff: Retaining old versions uses memory; pruning can remove historical answers

demos.execution: Exact recorded input/measurement/source plus calculated ratio; no GPU run is implied
demos.inputs: Complete recorded-row comparison, selected row, mode, output, qubits and export
demos.normal: Comparable CPU/GPU medians and ratio from same row
demos.boundary: Full-state transfer and differing mode baselines explained
demos.repair: Constrained recorded selector; invalid arbitrary measurements not accepted
demos.reset: Dedicated reset restores recorded baseline row
demos.provenance: Historical pinned public JSON and methods; no live GPU execution
demos.journey: Compare observable/full-state rows and inspect source/method
demos.principle: Returning the whole state has a different data-transfer scope
demos.intermediate: Recorded paired medians, source/mode/output row and full-row comparison
demos.tradeoff: Source runs differ; speed ratio is not accuracy or whole-program performance

demos.execution: BigInt reference and implemented compensated products
demos.inputs: Four editable numbers, cancelling/typical cases, live sweep
demos.normal: Compares plain and compensated result to exact reference
demos.boundary: Cancellation and invalid/empty numeric input
demos.repair: Edit rejected field or restore typical inputs
demos.reset: Dedicated reset clears errors, sweep and current input
demos.provenance: Browser arithmetic, synthetic cases, scoped to product rounding
demos.journey: Change operands, inspect lost digits, reject malformed value, run sweep
demos.principle: Nearly cancelling products can lose meaningful floating-point digits
demos.intermediate: Operand controls, plain/compensated result and reference error
demos.tradeoff: Compensation reduces rounding error but does not make general arithmetic exact

demos.execution: Normalized complex state computed; gate limit explicitly disables additions and undo restores them
demos.inputs: Visitor gate sequence, undo, reset and circuit/state export
demos.normal: Bell state creates two equal-probability basis outcomes
demos.boundary: Circuit limit silently ignores further gates at baseline
demos.repair: No undo or explicit limit feedback at baseline
demos.reset: Reset clears circuit; qubit count rebuilds state
demos.provenance: Browser state-vector toy, not GPU performance/exact arithmetic proof
demos.journey: Build circuit, inspect phase/probability, undo and reach declared limit
demos.principle: Each gate evolves complex state amplitudes
demos.intermediate: Gate sequence, probability/phase bars and normalization of actual state
demos.tradeoff: Browser state-vector growth is bounded; it is not a GPU timing run

demos.execution: Kalman innovation/gain/uncertainty computed; custom data is not claimed to contain known planted truth
demos.inputs: Visitor observation/drift-label CSV, measurement noise and per-step cursor
demos.normal: Filter estimates fair value and flags planted drift
demos.boundary: Noise produces false calls; current prose overstates universal comparison
demos.repair: No supplied observation sequence or estimate/covariance inspector
demos.reset: Shared reset restores noise and seed
demos.provenance: Synthetic simplified filter; not unpublished competition code
demos.journey: Supply observed prices, inspect slope uncertainty and trigger decision
demos.principle: A filter balances prediction with uncertain observations
demos.intermediate: Observation cursor, innovation, gain, slope uncertainty and drift decisions
demos.tradeoff: Noise assumptions affect sensitivity; custom labels are not authenticated truth

demos.execution: Implemented stable masked softmax
demos.inputs: Editable named action scores/legal flags, local JSON import, template, probability cards and temperature
demos.normal: Illegal moves receive zero probability
demos.boundary: All moves masked still assigns best decoration to first card
demos.repair: Named input validation, visible refusal, editable correction and reset; malformed input clears stale output
demos.reset: Shared reset restores initial options/temperature
demos.provenance: Invented logits, not a trained PTCG model or engine judgment
demos.journey: Edit action scores/legal flags, inspect normalization, handle no legal move
demos.principle: Mask illegal actions before normalizing probabilities
demos.intermediate: Editable scores/legal flags, normalized bars and all-masked abstention
demos.tradeoff: This is an independent scoring illustration, not the trained game agent

demos.execution: Implemented empirical risk threshold over synthetic actions
demos.inputs: Editable labelled calibration/evaluation JSON, target budget and per-action inspection
demos.normal: Calibration and fresh sample have separate outcomes
demos.boundary: Unconditional break rate confused with conformal guarantee
demos.repair: Named input validation, visible refusal, editable correction and reset; malformed input clears stale output
demos.reset: Shared reset restores target and generated actions
demos.provenance: Independent empirical calibration; not the project model and not a conformal guarantee
demos.journey: Edit labelled cases, calibrate threshold, inspect accepted rule breaks
demos.principle: Calibrated threshold trades abstention against accepted violations
demos.intermediate: Labelled calibration/evaluation cases and per-action threshold plot
demos.tradeoff: An empirical threshold is not a future-risk or conformal guarantee

demos.execution: Recorded figures and summaries only; absent paths are explained, not invented
demos.inputs: Recorded study, assumption and metric selection; paired curves and exact-record export
demos.normal: Recorded treatment/control figures have pinned sources
demos.boundary: Limitations and non-supporting results stated in copy
demos.repair: No record-level comparison/exploration controls
demos.reset: Reload initial stage; no explicit study reset at baseline
demos.provenance: Pinned recorded synthetic/public-data results; not live execution
demos.journey: Select recorded study and input assumption, compare control and evidence
demos.principle: Recorded controls distinguish an effect from a convenient headline
demos.intermediate: Study/assumption/metric comparisons, available archived paths and raw data
demos.tradeoff: Selecting evidence is not running a fresh experiment

demos.execution: Training winner receives a later-window audit; UI explicitly warns that repeated tuning is test leakage
demos.inputs: Candidate-seed offset, search count, full ranked candidate inspector and export
demos.normal: Chosen noise candidate fits search window by chance
demos.boundary: Later-window scores are visible, so changing search parameters is explicitly labelled repeated testing, never a sealed evaluation
demos.repair: No inspectable candidates or new independent seed control
demos.reset: Shared reset restores count and fixed data
demos.provenance: Synthetic candidates predict nothing by construction
demos.journey: Change candidate seeds; inspect training ranking and selected later-window result; export exact run and reset
demos.principle: Searching many noise candidates can inflate the best training score
demos.intermediate: Full training ranking, chosen candidate and later-window audit
demos.tradeoff: The audit remains visible; repeated tuning is explicitly not a sealed test

demos.execution: Pinned licensed Python performs fragment and whole-file checks; one missing block recovers, two in the same group refuse
demos.inputs: Editable UTF-8 file, fragment removal/corruption, recovery/download; separate seeded raw channel
demos.normal: Encode Unicode; remove a data fragment and recover exact UTF-8 bytes
demos.boundary: Two data losses in one group refuse output; corrupt metadata and unavailable runtime stay explicit
demos.repair: Restore a fragment and recover; repair text and re-encode; runtime load failure can retry
demos.reset: Shared reset discards input, fragment selection and old output; edits invalidate old verdict
demos.provenance: Unmodified MIT Python codec at local candidate b8a7089 with source hashes; digital utility, no physical DNA claim
demos.journey: Enter text spanning two fragments; encode; remove one and verify recovery; remove another and observe refusal; restore and recover; edit invalidates output
demos.principle: One XOR parity equation recovers one unavailable block per group
demos.intermediate: Actual fragment states, Python recovery indices, byte-level XOR inspector and verified digest
demos.tradeoff: Two unavailable blocks leave two unknowns; decoder refuses rather than guesses

demos.execution: Implemented interval overlap checker
demos.inputs: Custom named intervals, explicit weekday/time fields, sample catalogue, removal and schedule export
demos.normal: Non-overlapping sections can coexist
demos.boundary: Conflicting interval names its existing section
demos.repair: Named input validation, visible refusal, editable correction and reset; malformed input clears stale output
demos.reset: Shared reset clears selected schedule
demos.provenance: Invented course codes, independent scheduling exercise
demos.journey: Add custom interval, resolve exact conflict, remove and export
demos.principle: Intervals conflict when their occupied times overlap
demos.intermediate: Editable intervals, visible weekly placement and named conflict/agenda
demos.tradeoff: Half-open endpoints can touch without conflict; timetable is a synthetic model

demos.execution: Implemented Black-Scholes/SSVI and 3D projection
demos.inputs: Plot mode, financial parameters and view rotation
demos.normal: Surface and point readouts change from calculated values
demos.boundary: Expiry/volatility/skew ranges show consequential shape changes
demos.repair: Constrained finite parameter controls; parity reported
demos.reset: Shared reset rebuilds original surface and parameters
demos.provenance: Model formulas, not calibrated market forecasts
demos.journey: Compare Greeks, change volatility, rotate by keyboard, inspect parity
demos.principle: Price and sensitivities vary with model inputs
demos.intermediate: Computed option surface, selected point readout and put-call parity
demos.tradeoff: Black-Scholes assumptions and browser model outputs are not market quotes

demos.execution: Implemented Fourier transform and path reconstruction
demos.inputs: Draw own path or upload image; circles, speed, pause
demos.normal: Circles reconstruct visitor path and show approximation error
demos.boundary: Too little detail and invalid image/drawing inputs
demos.repair: Draw another path or choose a valid image
